svg.text: the claw gets a face, a name, and feelings

g.text: The claw is already the main character

text.tspan: You look at the claw the entire game. You cheer
for it, you beg it, you shout at it. It is on
screen more than any plushie — and right now it
has no face and no name. Giving it one costs a
nose, two eyes and a mouth, and turns every single
drop into a little story about somebody trying
their best.
parked at the top, blinking,
ready when you are
you are moving her — she
squints at the pile
the prongs close. She is
trying so hard.
she is carrying a cutie to the
chute
the cutie slipped. She feels
terrible.
nobody has played for a minute

g.text: Why this is the cheapest big idea in the binder

text.tspan: The claw already changes between six states in the code: idle, falling, closing, lifting, travelling and
returning. Those six states are exactly the six faces on this page. Nothing new has to be invented — the game
already knows how the claw feels. It just is not showing it yet.

g.text: Decision ID: CMC-2026-___ · Page label: PROPOSED

svg.text: Made for Ella — Creator, Owner & Game Boss
